Standing assumptions

Shown and hidden with the hidden attribute. The DOM is preserved across toggles.

Fill rate is measured on departure rather than on the booked plan, so a trailer released early counts at whatever it actually carried.

On-time is measured against the committed window, not the planned window. A re-plan inside the day does not reset the clock.

Volume excludes returns and inter-depot balancing moves, both of which are settled on a separate ledger.

Any lane below the 120k threshold for two consecutive periods is flagged for review regardless of its on-time performance.
